description: This file contains implementation of Orleans grains related to stream lifecycle testing, including state management, consumer and producer grains, and stream observer classes.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleTestGrainState
classes.description: Holds the state for stream lifecycle test grains, including stream provider name, stream object, producer/consumer flags, message/error counts, and subscription handles.

classes.name: GenericArg
classes.description: Base class for stream-related argument types, with properties A (string) and B (int).

classes.name: AsyncObserverArg
classes.description: Derived from GenericArg, used as argument type for asynchronous stream observers.

classes.name: AsyncObservableArg
classes.description: Derived from GenericArg, used as argument type for asynchronous stream observables.

classes.name: AsyncStreamArg
classes.description: Derived from GenericArg, used as argument type for stream-related data.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandleArg
classes.description: Derived from GenericArg, used as argument for stream subscription handles.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleTestGrainBase
classes.description: Base class for stream lifecycle grains, providing common functionality such as stream initialization, activation/deactivation recording, and logging.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleConsumerGrain
classes.description: Consumer grain implementation managing stream subscriptions, reconnections, and state management.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleProducerGrain
classes.description: Producer grain implementation responsible for sending stream items, managing producer state, and handling activation/deactivation.

classes.name: MyStreamObserver
classes.description: Generic class implementing IAsyncObserver to observe stream items, errors, and completion, tracking counts.

classes.name: ClosedTypeStreamObserver
classes.description: Specialized stream observer for AsyncObserverArg type.

classes.name: IClosedTypeAsyncObservable
classes.description: Interface for asynchronous observable with AsyncObserverArg type.

classes.name: IClosedTypeAsyncStream
classes.description: Interface for asynchronous stream with AsyncStreamArg type.

classes.name: ClosedTypeStreamSubscriptionHandle
classes.description: Implementation of stream subscription handle for closed type streams.

methods.name: RecordActivate
methods.description: Records activation of the grain, optionally counting activation if COUNT_ACTIVATE_DEACTIVATE is defined.

methods.name: RecordDeactivate
methods.description: Records deactivation of the grain, optionally counting deactivation if COUNT_ACTIVATE_DEACTIVATE is defined.

methods.name: InitStream
methods.description: Initializes or resets the stream with a given stream ID and provider name, managing state and logging.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, including reconnection to streams and restoring subscriptions.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation, recording the event.

methods.name: GetReceivedCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items received by the consumer.

methods.name: GetErrorsCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of errors encountered by the consumer.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Simple method to check if the grain is responsive.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain as a consumer to a specified stream.

methods.name: TestBecomeConsumerSlim
methods.description: Sets up a consumer with additional extension binding and registration logic.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Removes a consumer subscription handle from the stream.

methods.name: ClearGrain
methods.description: Clears all consumer subscriptions and resets state.

methods.name: SendItem
methods.description: Sends an item into the stream if the grain is a producer.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Configures the grain as a producer and sends an initial message.

methods.name: DoDeactivateNoClose
methods.description: Deactivates the grain without closing the stream, used for testing.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream items, incrementing count and logging.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Handles stream completion, logging total items and errors.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream errors, incrementing error count and logging.
